info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Aggregation By Customer Id-spec
info.description: The Customer Aggregation Update API enables businesses to modify customer-specific aggregation settings based on unique customer IDs. This endpoint supports the updating of aggregated data, ensuring that businesses maintain accurate and relevant information for each customer. Typical consumers of this API include developers and data analysts who require precise data aggregation tailored to individual customers' needs. Use cases often involve adjusting reporting parameters or refining data insights for better customer engagement.

put.description: This operation allows you to update the information of a specific customer identified by their unique ID. All relevant details should be included in the request body to ensure a successful update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a specific customer identified by the customer ID 'CUST-100045'. The request must include a JSON object containing the updated information about the customer.
